question.problem: Let $A(-2,1)$ and $B(2,3).$ Find $\overrightarrow{AB}$ in terms of $\mathbf{i}$ and $\mathbf{j}.$
question.worked_solution:
Our vector is shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14252323/assets/76c98067c9780e9c903dda8657b67a2db473ecd8ef24e53e2262ba2f46a4293a.png)

We have 

$$
\begin{aligned} & \overset{\to }{OA}=a=-2i+j, \\  & \overset{\to }{OB}=b=2i+3j.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, from $\triangle OAB,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =\overset{\to }{AO}+\overset{\to }{OB} \\  & =-\overset{\to }{OA}+\overset{\to }{OB} \\  & =b-a \\  & =(2i+3j)-(-2i+j) \\  & =4i+2j.\end{aligned}
$$
